runbooks.title: 5xx spike after deploy
steps: Confirm the spike correlates with a recent deploy in the release log.
Roll back to the last known-good release.
Check DB connection-pool saturation (pgbouncer) and raise pool if starved.
Re-enable the canary gate before rolling forward.

runbooks.title: Payment gateway timeouts
steps: Check upstream gateway status page.
Verify the circuit breaker opened; confirm retry budget is not exhausted.
Fail over to the secondary gateway region if error rate > 5%.
Drain and replay the settlement queue after recovery.

runbooks.title: Redis latency / evictions
steps: Inspect redis eviction rate and memory usage.
Identify hot keys; enable client-side TTL jitter.
Fail over to the redis replica if the primary is saturated.
Scale the cache tier and re-warm.

runbooks.title: DB connection-pool exhaustion
steps: Check pgbouncer active vs. idle connections.
Kill idle-in-transaction sessions.
Raise the pool ceiling within DB max_connections headroom.
Find the caller leaking connections and patch.

runbooks.title: Auth failures / token errors
steps: Check node clock skew (NTP).
Force a JWKS refresh; verify the signing key rotated correctly.
Purge the stale token-validation cache.
Confirm downstream services picked up the new keys.

runbooks.title: Elasticsearch red cluster
steps: Check disk high-watermark on data nodes.
Free disk or add capacity; clear the read-only-allow-delete block.
Reroute unassigned shards once disk is healthy.
Verify green status before restoring traffic.

runbooks.title: Kafka consumer lag
steps: Check partition assignment and rebalance storms.
Scale consumers up to the partition count.
Investigate slow downstream (email-gateway) backpressure.
Only reset offsets as a last resort, with sign-off.

runbooks.title: Model-serving errors
steps: Check feature-store latency and timeouts.
Fall back to popularity-based recommendations.
Verify the model artifact loaded correctly after deploy.
Scale serving replicas if CPU-bound.

runbooks.title: OOMKilled / memory leak
steps: Capture a heap dump before the next restart.
Roll back the suspect release.
Bump memory limits as a temporary mitigation.
File a leak bug with the heap dump attached.

runbooks.title: TLS certificate expiry
steps: Confirm the expired certificate and its SAN coverage.
Renew and deploy the certificate.
Reload the ingress / load balancer.
Verify the full chain and expiry monitoring.
